_meta.note: PUBLIC chargen roll/lookup tables from 4001 Character 2-5 (functional data). Range tables use 1d100 unless `die` says otherwise; `mod`/notes per the rules. Sunsign is date-based (1d12 month + 1d30 day → day-of-year 1..360). Supplement/homebrew layers deep-merge on top via merge-util.

socialClass.note: Feudal column. Random generation is NOT recommended (GM chooses); table is for NPCs. Slave is Rethem-only (treat as Serf elsewhere on Hârn).

siblingRank.note: Family size = sibling rank + (1d6 - 1). Eldest is often favored: +5 when rolling Estrangement.

entries.note: lives with another family; reroll Offspring sub-table at +30
acknowledged by father if roll was 76-80
reroll for father's relation to clanhead; recurse on another Distant Relation

estrangement.note: Eldest child +5. Small/unextended clan +20 (but always treat a natural 01 as Outcast).

occupationGen.note: Character 14 Occupation Generation: occupations available per social class + a 1d100 roll within the proper culture column. `r` holds per-culture ranges (Tribal/Viking/Feudal/Imperial/Sindarin/Khuzan; absent = unavailable). `id` links to occupations.json (Soldier variants → soldier; Cleric(noble) → cleric-shaman; Bailiff/Knight → knight-bailiff; Chieftain has no 4001 occupation bundle).

psyche.note: Mental Disorder table (gated OFF by the 'No psyche' house rule). 66-70 = roll twice more; 38 Multiple Personality = generate a 2nd personality. Pair with psycheSeverity.

medical.note: Sex-specific d100 columns (mlo/mhi = male, flo/fhi = female). Opt-in (house rule). Medical Option: 2 points to attribute(s) before risking the roll. (*) traits: Sindarin treat as Sterile. 66-70 = roll twice more.

entries.name: Addiction
entries.effect: Will×4 to resist first use, Will×1 each subsequent

entries.name: Albinism
entries.effect: −10 special penalty to most skills in bright light; sunburns easily

entries.name: Allergy
entries.effect: Special Penalty 20 to all skills near the source

entries.name: Hemophilia*
entries.effect: bloodloss attempts −40; females are carriers only

culture.note: Determined by Birthplace; most Hârnic characters are Feudal.

familyWealth.note: Starting funds (in d / pennies) by social class × wealth level (Character 17). Spent on the HârnWorld price list + the Combat 3-4 weapon/armour tables; the price list is NOT in 4001 core. GM may vary by family occupation; estrangement can shift it.

frame.note: Modify the 3d6 roll by species/sex before lookup: Human Female -3, Sindarin -2, Khuzdul +3. Frame modifies optimum weight (Scant -20%, Light -10%, Medium 0, Heavy +10%, Massive +20%).

comelinessDesc.note: Descriptor for the Comeliness (CML) attribute value (Sindarin +2).

moralityDesc.note: Descriptor NAME for the Morality (MOR) attribute value. NAMES are functional labels (public); the full prose descriptions are IP flavor (owner-populated in flavor.*.json, not shipped).

heightBase.note: Height (inches) = base + 4d6. GM mods: Ivinian +1, nobility +2, urban poor -2.

weightByHeight.note: Optimum weight (lb) by height in inches; multiply by the frame factor. Heights below 40 use 40; above 89 use 89.

complexion.note: Human column. Sindarin: 01-97 Fair / 98-99 Medium / 00 Dark. Khuzdul: 01-90 Fair / 91-00 Medium.

hairColor.note: Human column (youth). Modify +25 for Fair complexion, -25 for Dark.

eyeColor.note: Human column. Modify +25 for Fair complexion, -25 for Dark.

sunsign.note: Derived from birthdate (1d12 month + 1d30 day). day-of-year = (month-1)*30 + day. Cusp = within 2 days of a boundary (benefits of both signs).

military.note: Character 27 Military Careers. ALL-military common skills open for every unit EXCEPT Militia; on overlap use the higher OML. Recruitment END×mult is informational (chargen assumes already enlisted). Fighting Orders deferred (with religion). knight:true = the noble-knight unit for that culture.

clerics.note: Character 23 Cleric occupation skills. Bundle = ALL (common) + the deity-specific list, unioned with the higher OML winning on overlap. RML = Ritual opened to SB×4; Piety = Will×5. Invocations (deity articles / 4401) are deferred. `special` holds non-OML grants (70+SB scripts, optional temple tongues, choose-N).

orders.name: Order of the Spear of Shattered Sorrow

fightingOrders.name: Order of the Lady of Paladins

orders.name: Order of the Lord of Chaos

mages.note: Character 26 Satia-Mavari Occupational Skills. Bundle = ALL + chosen convocation list (higher OML). The Convocation + Neutral open as CML magic skills (→ magic block); CML defaults to CSB×3 (an HHHH chantry). Spells deferred. csb = CSB attrs (Char 25); convocational sunsign mods not yet applied.

instruments.note: Common instruments — pick when opening a Musician specialty. General list (GM may add culture-specific).
